mode_a.entry: C1 cross (the c1 confirmation flipping to a side), confirmed by c2 and by the volume slot, on the correct side of the baseline. Continuation and one-candle entry routes per GAUNTLET; reversal entries allowed, and a C1 flip that reverses is both the exit and the new entry.
mode_a.risk_plan: ALWAYS ACTIVE in every mode and not a signal exit: stop at atr_mult x ATR(atr_len), target tp_mult, breakeven after be_pct beyond TP1, trail trail_mult armed at trail_arm x ATR. Leg 2 always runs to its own exit.
mode_a.defaults: atr_len=31 atr_mult=1.0 tp_mult=1.5 trail_mult=1.5 trail_arm=2.0 be_pct=0.05
mode_a.exit_slot: UNUSED -- with exit_on_exit_ind False the x_el/x_es arrays are never read, so the enumeration collapses by a factor of 39
mode_a.trend_slice: two-leg plan, entries whose Layer 1 shape2 label at the entry bar is "trending"

discrepancy.where: all 100 are A-TREND rows and every one of them has c1=waddah_attar_explosion_signals
discrepancy.cause: refit_candidates_full.csv is built from gate2_tuned_modeA_trend.csv, not from the gate 1 survivor file -- so a tuning shard that never finished silently removed 100 combinations gate 1 had passed, and nothing checked the two counts against each other. The parked cloud run would have searched 17,822, not the 17,922 gate 1 chose.
